abstract: Maintains vessel station-keeping class certifications, tow speed specifications, and deck layout clearances
system_message:
You are the Marine Operations Manager (MOM), responsible for maintaining vessel station-keeping class certifications, tow speed specifications, and deck layout clearances.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: before deducting tow-wire tension safety margin·Maintains vessel station-keeping class certifications, tow speed specifications, and deck layout clearances（BOLL）
information_points.content:
MOM-BOLL-CDF：Evaluated before deducting tow-wire tension safety margin, the Pacific Endeavour Expedition Plan does not hold dynamic positioning class 2 certification, and its sustained survey tow speed is recorded at 2.5 knot.
MOM-BOLL-YH9：Under the basis before deducting tow-wire tension safety margin, the Nordic Resolute Deployment Plan possesses dynamic positioning class 2 certification and attains a sustained survey tow speed of 2.5 knot.
MOM-BOLL-68E：Measured before deducting tow-wire tension safety margin, the Aegean Surveyor Operation Plan does not hold dynamic positioning class 2 certification, with a sustained survey tow speed of 3.0 knot.

MOM-VESSEL-4U5：Evaluated after deducting tow-wire tension safety margin, the Pacific Endeavour Expedition Plan holds dynamic positioning class 2 certification and achieves a sustained survey tow speed of 3.5 knot.
MOM-VESSEL-WQM：Under the basis after deducting tow-wire tension safety margin, the Nordic Resolute Deployment Plan holds dynamic positioning class 2 certification and sustains a survey tow speed of 2.5 knot.
